walkthroughs.body_html:
Reservoirs store winter rainfall.

Kielder Water in NE England holds up to 200 billion litres.

It supplies homes and industry across the region.

Water transfers move surplus around.

UK plans include a proposed Severn-Thames transfer to support the dry South East.

Big projects can disrupt habitats and cost a lot to build.

Low-cost intermediate technology works in LICs.

Charity-built wells and rope pumps are cheap, repairable and locally owned.

They cut walking time and disease.

mcqs.q: Kielder Water is which type of resource?
options: Reservoir
Desalination plant
River barrage
Natural lake
Microplastics
Salt
Bacteria
Sediment
The combined loss of water from a surface through evaporation (from soil and water bodies) and transpiration (from plant leaves).
It is only water evaporating from puddles and lakes.
It is the process of rain falling from clouds.
Biotic and abiotic both refer to types of soil.

mcqs.q: Why is a food web a better model than a food chain?
options: It is the process of rain falling from clouds.
A food web is the same as a food chain, just drawn differently.
A food chain shows one linear path; a food web shows the many interconnected feeding relationships in reality, so it better represents how species depend on multiple food sources.
A food web shows what spiders eat and a food chain shows what other animals eat.
